# Installation

autogeom requires Python 3.13 or later.
It is published as a conda package on [prefix.dev](https://prefix.dev/channels/avcopan/automech) and as a Python package on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/autogeom/).

## With Pixi

In a [Pixi](https://pixi.sh) workspace, add the `avcopan/automech` channel and then autogeom:

```bash
pixi workspace channel add https://repo.prefix.dev/avcopan/automech
pixi add autogeom
```

RDKit (InChI/SMILES conversions and bond perception) and py3Dmol (interactive viewing) are installed with it.

:::{.callout-note}
xyzrender, which `render_svg` and `render_gif` use, is only on PyPI, so the conda package leaves it out.
To render images, add it as a PyPI dependency:

```bash
pixi add --pypi xyzrender
```

Everything else works without it, and the render functions raise an `ImportError` explaining this if it is missing.
:::

## With pip or uv

```bash
pip install autogeom   # or: uv add autogeom
```

This installs xyzrender too.

## For development

See [Contributing](https://github.com/avcopan/autogeom/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
